en.answer: Even in the given situation, that effect of <<16516>> was activated while it was revealed in the hand. Therefore, you can choose to Set a Spell/Trap from your Deck.
en.question: While a <<16516>> in my hand is revealed by <<4958>> or <<13005>>, I activate its effect that Special Summons it. When this effect resolves, can I Set a Spell/Trap from my Deck?
